description: Get the PTAB validity-challenge history for a US patent: who challenged it (petitioner), the patent owner, challenge type (IPR/PGR/CBM), filing/institution dates, and outcome (patent_survived / final_written_decision / terminated). Answers 'was this patent attacked at the PTAB, by whom, and did it survive?'. Free, public-record.
name: challenges

challenges.description: PTAB challenges (trial number, type, petitioner, owner, dates, status, outcome).
